purpose: Machine-readable cross-chat continuity index. Prevent rediscovery loops by forcing source recovery before new gates.

current_global_frontier.rule: Do not let historical C022/C023/C023R diagnostics or scoped bicameral carrier passes silently replace global APMA frontier authority.

JUXTAPOSE.role: Adaptive search prioritization backed by exact replay; prediction/search priority is not proof authority.

AKINATOR.role: Adaptive exact-question skeleton. Question count and answer cost are separate resources; small question count alone is not a polynomial SAT algorithm.
AKINATOR.known_blocker: deterministic polynomial-time proof-carrying exact answerer for sufficiently useful progress questions

CAPTAIN_OBVIOUS.role: Status-first compression: recover full relevant history, identify what is already solved, choose one nearest missing obligation, avoid unnecessary redesign.

JANUS_SOVEREIGN.role: Governance/commit authority; must not be conflated with scientific theorem authority.
JANUS_SOVEREIGN.warning: Library contains SovereignGate implementations in other JANUS/RBLGANUL lineages. Do not silently treat those as the canonical TRUMP Janus-Sovereign contract without provenance binding.

JANUS_DEMIURGE.role: Construct exact candidates/transitions/certificates; construction is distinct from governance and scientific promotion.

HRAIN_INAIHR_BICAMERAL_EXPLANATION.role: Hrain supplies deterministic structural observation; iNaiHR supplies candidate-only explanation proposals with provenance; Captain/PCNER red-teams assumptions/resources; TRUMP alone exact-replays and admits/rejects; Sovereign may commit only after frozen PASS.
HRAIN_INAIHR_BICAMERAL_EXPLANATION.known_closed_scope: single-variable incidence articulation conditioning over explicit Boolean relation tables when both exact branches replay into sealed compositional basis portfolios
HRAIN_INAIHR_BICAMERAL_EXPLANATION.known_blocker: historical successor blocker was a connected mixed raw core without a valid single-variable articulation explanation; later successor states v2.6-v3.0 have advanced beyond this blocker

BICAMERAL_CANONICAL_MINCUT_LOGWIDTH.role: Discover a globally minimum variable-only cut by polynomial node-splitting/max-flow rather than subset enumeration; authorize raw conditioning only when 2^k<=L before enumeration.
BICAMERAL_CANONICAL_MINCUT_LOGWIDTH.closed_scope: Polynomial canonical cut discovery and exact raw conditioning when 2^k<=L.
BICAMERAL_CANONICAL_MINCUT_LOGWIDTH.firewall: When 2^k>L the gate returns OPEN before raw branch enumeration.

EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.role: Representation/query-contract barrier plus strict affine-syndrome exact quotient door. Equality of syndrome is admissible only when every frozen downstream observable exactly factors through the syndrome basis.
EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.known_positive_scope: Strict affine downstream contract with polynomial syndrome image and exact factor maps/reconstruction.
EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.known_barrier: Unrestricted coordinate-observation contracts can force 2^k distinguishable classes.
EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.forbidden_overclaim: Do not assume arbitrary cut components are affine and do not treat the U1 representation barrier as a general SAT lower bound.

BICAMERAL_OVERWIDTH_CUT_SUPPORT_INTERSEC.role: For an overwidth canonical cut whose cut-separated constraint-bearing components are singleton explicit relations, project each relation's existing rows to the cut and intersect the supports; reconstruct one original row per component for an exact witness.
BICAMERAL_OVERWIDTH_CUT_SUPPORT_INTERSEC.closed_scope: Overwidth canonical mincut plus exactly one explicit relation per cut-separated component; exact SAT/witness by support intersection with carrier size bounded by explicit input rows and zero raw 2^k enumeration.
BICAMERAL_OVERWIDTH_CUT_SUPPORT_INTERSEC.current_successor_blocker: Successor lines v2.9 and v3.0 close full-cut-anchor join trees and exactly-two-relation no-anchor components.

BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.role: For an overwidth canonical cut with multi-relation cut components, use only raw full-cut anchor-row projections as candidate cut states, verify a deterministic relation tree satisfies running intersection, exact-test each anchor state by tree semijoin/DP, intersect component supports and replay one original-row witness per relation.
BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.closed_scope: Overwidth cut components with an explicit raw full-cut anchor and a verified running-intersection relation tree. Candidate cut states are bounded by anchor input rows; exact component semantics use tree semijoin/DP with no raw cut cube or full join materialization.
BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.negative_authority: Predecessor-admitted hostile three-relation private-variable cycle remains OPEN_NO_VERIFIED_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE in both candidate and independent checker.
BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.current_successor_blocker: The no-full-cut-anchor exactly-two-relation case is now closed by v3.0; remaining components contain three or more relations without a uniform polynomial boundary elimination theorem.

BICAMERAL_DERIVED_TWO_RELATION_BOUNDARY_.role: For an overwidth canonical cut component without a raw full-cut anchor, when the component has exactly two relations whose scope union covers B, derive the exact component boundary support by one natural join over explicit row pairs followed by projection to B; store an original compatible row-pair witness and intersect supports across cut components.
BICAMERAL_DERIVED_TWO_RELATION_BOUNDARY_.closed_scope: Overwidth canonical cut with singleton or exactly-two-relation cut components; pair components need no raw full-cut anchor but their scope union must cover B. Exactly one natural join is permitted, with |P_C| <= |R1|*|R2| <= O(L^2), zero raw cut-cube enumeration and exact witness replay.
BICAMERAL_DERIVED_TWO_RELATION_BOUNDARY_.negative_authority: Any component with three or more relations returns OPEN_COMPONENT_RELATION_COUNT_GT_2 before a join chain; incomplete pair coverage returns OPEN_INCOMPLETE_TWO_RELATION_CUT_COVER.
BICAMERAL_DERIVED_TWO_RELATION_BOUNDARY_.repair_history: Immutable v1 serialization failure preserved; v1.1 changes only JSON-safe provenance serialization while the mathematical v1 blob remains frozen.
BICAMERAL_DERIVED_TWO_RELATION_BOUNDARY_.current_successor_blocker: Three-or-more-relation no-full-cut-anchor components need an exact boundary message with a uniform original-L polynomial exponent independent of relation count.

FULL_HISTORY_SPIRAL.role: Diagnostic/history reconstruction only; provenance-indexed synthesis before selecting a new gate.

UNIFORM_RAW_AFFINE_3PLUS_SUPERSEDED_ROUT.role: Anti-loop diagnostic showing that all-affine 3+ raw inputs are already captured by the earlier raw/compositional basis layer before mincut discovery; do not repair or reintroduce as a current frontier gate.

BICAMERAL_GUARDED_BOUNDED_OUTPUT_ELIMINA.role: For predecessor-open mixed/non-affine 3+ relation overwidth components, perform exact existential bucket elimination in one frozen canonical order only when each current explicit bucket row-product is <= L^2 before expansion; otherwise return OPEN before enumerating the failed bucket.
BICAMERAL_GUARDED_BOUNDED_OUTPUT_ELIMINA.closed_scope: Predecessor-open mixed/non-affine 3+ relation components for which every bucket in the single frozen elimination order has pre-expansion row product <= L^2. Exact natural join/projection, reverse witness replay and original tuple verification remain within one fixed polynomial envelope.
BICAMERAL_GUARDED_BOUNDED_OUTPUT_ELIMINA.negative_authority: Overbudget bucket returns OPEN_BUCKET_PRODUCT_BUDGET before failed-bucket enumeration; OPEN is not negative evidence.
BICAMERAL_GUARDED_BOUNDED_OUTPUT_ELIMINA.current_successor_blocker: Reduce exact effective complexity of the first canonical overbudget bucket before materialization, without raising the budget exponent or exponential order search.

BICAMERAL_BUCKET_COMMON_CORE_SEMIJOIN_PR.role: Before materializing an overbudget target-component bucket, derive the raw common variable core C, intersect explicit projection supports on C, reject exact empty support, otherwise semijoin-filter original rows while preserving all non-core coordinates and hand off to the unchanged sealed v3.2 L^2 guarded engine.
BICAMERAL_BUCKET_COMMON_CORE_SEMIJOIN_PR.closed_scope: Target-component first private overbudget buckets of original explicit relation factors where exact common-core support intersection is empty, or semijoin filtering reduces the explicit bucket product sufficiently for the sealed v3.2 guarded engine to admit. No non-core payload variable is projected away.
BICAMERAL_BUCKET_COMMON_CORE_SEMIJOIN_PR.negative_authority: A sticky control retains nonempty common support but filtered product 1099511627776 > L^2 and remains OPEN with zero failed-bucket enumeration.
BICAMERAL_BUCKET_COMMON_CORE_SEMIJOIN_PR.current_successor_blocker: After exact common-core semijoin, nonempty support remains but factor-local/partial-overlap multiplicity keeps the filtered bucket product above L^2.

BICAMERAL_UNIQUE_CORE_RESIDUAL_COMPONENT.role: After exact unique-common-core conditioning, derive residual relation-overlap components. Singleton components project directly; two-relation components use exactly one exact natural join and projection; component carriers are stored additively with no global residual Cartesian product.
BICAMERAL_UNIQUE_CORE_RESIDUAL_COMPONENT.closed_scope: Unique common-core state, complete target coverage, and every conditioned residual overlap component containing at most two target relations.
BICAMERAL_UNIQUE_CORE_RESIDUAL_COMPONENT.current_blocker: Residual connected component size >=3 after unique-core conditioning; multiple common-core states remain a separate secondary blocker.
BICAMERAL_UNIQUE_CORE_RESIDUAL_COMPONENT.firewall: Do not chain pair joins through arbitrary 3+ components; profile structure first. No general partial-overlap factorization claim.

BICAMERAL_RESIDUAL_3PLUS_STRUCTURE_FOREN.role: Diagnostic-only exact structural profile of the first residual component >2 after unique-core conditioning; no solver authority.

aliases: Unique-core residual single-variable separator factorized payload
BICAMERAL_RESIDUAL_SINGLE_VARIABLE_SEPAR.role: After an exact unique common-core state, derive one Boolean residual articulation variable from raw residual scopes, branch exactly on 0/1, recompute each branch dependency graph, and reuse only sealed residual <=2 carriers. SAT requires original witness replay; UNSAT requires both exact branch certificates.
BICAMERAL_RESIDUAL_SINGLE_VARIABLE_SEPAR.closed_scope: Unique common-core predecessor plus one raw-derived Boolean residual articulation variable whose exact two branches reduce to residual <=2 carriers or exact branch UNSAT.
BICAMERAL_RESIDUAL_SINGLE_VARIABLE_SEPAR.known_open: No admissible single-variable separator, any separator branch remaining GT2, and multiple exact common-core states.
BICAMERAL_RESIDUAL_SINGLE_VARIABLE_SEPAR.firewall: No 3plus join chain, no global residual Cartesian product, no L2 budget raise, no general residual separator tractability claim.

BICAMERAL_UNIQUE_CORE_RESIDUAL_PAIR_SEPA.role: Under a unique exact common-core state, scan unordered residual variable pairs in O(V^2), select the lexicographically first structurally admissible pair, branch on exactly four Boolean assignments, and reuse only sealed residual <=2 carriers.
BICAMERAL_UNIQUE_CORE_RESIDUAL_PAIR_SEPA.closed_scope: Unique-core residual GT2 inputs having a raw-derived residual variable pair whose four exact Boolean branches reduce to sealed <=2 carriers or exact UNSAT.
BICAMERAL_UNIQUE_CORE_RESIDUAL_PAIR_SEPA.known_blocker: Frozen K4 distinct-edge-variable residual component with no admissible pair; profile diagnostically before any separator size >=3 theorem.

before_new_mechanism: classify as NEW_MECHANISM, REDISCOVERY, SUCCESSOR_REPAIR, DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY, or SUPERSEDED_ROUTE
never: reconstruct a historical module from memory when a source can be recovered
promote a finite diagnostic to theorem evidence
let a search heuristic vote for scientific PASS
repeat fixed-k or raw overwidth enumeration after v3.0
rediscover the full-cut-anchor verified-join-tree carrier as if new
rediscover the no-full-cut-anchor exactly-two-relation one-join carrier as if new
assume affine quotient applicability without exact factor-through adequacy
materialize an unbounded join/project and call it polynomial
let polynomial degree grow with relation count while claiming one polynomial algorithm
repair or promote the superseded all-affine 3+ boundary gate
repeat guarded L^2 bucket elimination as if overbudget buckets were solved
raise the L^2 bucket budget exponent without a new structural theorem
enumerate an overbudget bucket and compress it afterward
rediscover common-core projection-support intersection semijoin as if new after v3.4
project away factor-local payload variables merely because they are outside the common core
treat sticky common-core OPEN as negative complexity evidence

update_policy: Append/index every newly recovered durable mechanism or alias when material to future work. Do not rely on conversational memory as the only copy.
